[spoiler=Expansion Post][b]Government Declaration of Shahban on the Integration of the Eastern Highland Territories[/b]
[i]Issued from Qarandah by the High Emir[/i]

The Government of Shahban hereby announces the formal and lawful integration of the Eastern Highland Territories into the sovereign jurisdiction of the Shahbani state.
This declaration follows an extended period of dialogue, consultation, and negotiation conducted between representatives of the Shahbani government and the recognized councils, elders, and communal authorities of the eastern highlands. These discussions were initiated at the request of the highland communities themselves and were carried out in accordance with longstanding regional customs and accepted principles of self-determination. The eastern highlands share deep historical, cultural, economic, and social ties with the Shahbani heartland. For generations, the peoples of these regions have maintained close connections through trade, kinship, religious practice, and mutual defense. Despite these ties, the absence of a stable administrative framework in the highlands has left local communities exposed to insecurity, legal uncertainty, and external pressure.
In recent months, representatives of the eastern mountain communities have formally expressed their desire to enter into a permanent political arrangement with Shahban. Their stated objectives include the establishment of predictable governance, access to legal protections, the safeguarding of traditional land rights, and the integration of local economies into a stable national framework.
After careful review, the Government of Shahban has accepted this request. Effective immediately, Shahban will extend its civil administration, legal order, and security coordination to the eastern highlands. This process will be conducted in a phased and orderly manner to ensure continuity, stability, and respect for local customs. Existing tribal councils and communal authorities will be preserved and incorporated into the Shahbani administrative system through transitional governance arrangements. Local leadership structures will retain a consultative role in matters of cultural, religious, and communal significance, while national law will provide the overarching legal framework necessary for long-term stability and development.
The Government of Shahban emphasizes that this integration is neither an act of annexation nor an expansion achieved through force. No military action preceded this decision, and no coercion was employed. The process reflects the voluntary alignment of historically connected highland communities with a state capable of guaranteeing security, representation, and economic continuity. To ensure public order and protect civilian life during the transition, Shahbani security forces will coordinate with local authorities to secure transport routes, population centers, and critical infrastructure. These measures are administrative and protective in nature and are intended solely to prevent disruption during the integration process. The incorporation of the eastern highlands is undertaken with full respect for international norms governing territorial administration and the expressed will of the resident population. Shahban reaffirms its commitment to peaceful relations with all neighboring states and rejects any characterization of this process as destabilizing or aggressive. Shahban views the integration of the eastern highlands as a stabilizing development for the broader region. By extending governance, legal clarity, and security to an area long characterized by fragmentation, Shahban seeks to reduce uncertainty, prevent exploitation, and contribute to regional predictability.
The Government of Shahban will engage transparently with international partners and relevant organizations to communicate the legal and administrative basis of this decision. Further details regarding governance structures, infrastructure investment, and social integration programs in the eastern highlands will be released in due course.
This declaration enters into force immediately. [/spoiler]
